title: IoT Smart Desk Orchestrator
bullets: Designed an ESP32-based smart desk monitor integrating 7 hardware components via MQTT.
Synced hardware status with a Tkinter desktop app using event-driven C++ logic, eliminating polling delays.

title: Shark Recovery
bullets: A revenue loss reducing platform using Razorpay and Twilio.
Merchant revenue loss occurs in multiple steps, this platform provides an AI enabled agentic workflow with multi-channel dispatch to attempt recovery of the revenue which has been lost.
